items.exampleEn: My little brother learned to paddle a boat this summer.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟今年夏天學會了划船。

items.exampleEn: His parachute opened just in time.
items.exampleZh: 他的降落傘及時打開了。

items.exampleEn: Takeoff was delayed because of the snow.
The campsite has showers and a small shop.
items.exampleZh: 營地有淋浴間和一家小商店。

items.exampleEn: A safari can be expensive but exciting.
items.exampleZh: 野生動物之旅可能很貴，但很刺激。
items.glossZh: 野生動物觀賞之旅；遊獵

items.exampleEn: The museum has a golden chariot from long ago.
items.exampleZh: 博物館有一輛很久以前的金色戰車。

items.exampleEn: The hostel is popular with backpackers.
items.exampleZh: 這家青年旅館很受背包客歡迎。

items.exampleEn: Clean the windscreen before you start driving.
items.exampleZh: 開車前先把擋風玻璃擦乾淨。

items.sentenceEn: We set up our tent at the campsite before dark.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在天黑前在營地搭好帳篷。

items.audioEn: Our plane will be ready for takeoff in five minutes, so please put on your seat belts.
items.audioZh: 我們的飛機五分鐘後準備起飛，請繫好安全帶。

items.sentenceEn: The young backpackers slept on the train to save money.
items.sentenceZh: 那些年輕背包客為了省錢在火車上睡覺。

items.sentenceEn: Rain made it hard to see through the windscreen.
items.sentenceZh: 下雨讓人很難看清擋風玻璃外面。

items.stemEn: We stayed at a ____ in the forest and slept in tents.
items.stemZh: 我們住在森林裡的一個營地，睡在帳篷裡。

items.stemEn: We had to ____ the small boat to the other side of the river.
items.stemZh: 我們得划槳把小船送到河的對岸。

items.passageEn: Leah is a young backpacker from a small town. Last year, she joined a safari in a large national park. She stayed at a campsite with ten other travelers and saw lions and elephants. One morning, a monkey jumped onto their car and sat on the windscreen. Later, the group took a boat trip, and everyone had to paddle. On the last day, Leah watched a man jump from a plane with a parachute.
items.passageZh: Leah 是來自一個小鎮的年輕背包客。去年，她參加了一個大型國家公園的野生動物之旅。她和另外十位旅客住在營地裡，看到了獅子和大象。有一天早上，一隻猴子跳上他們的車，坐在擋風玻璃上。後來，這群人去搭船，每個人都得划槳。最後一天，Leah 看到一個男人背著降落傘從飛機上跳下來。

questions.questionZh: 有一天早上發生了什麼事？
options: 一頭大象擋住了他們的路
一隻獅子慢慢走進營地
一艘小船在湖上翻覆了

questions.questionZh: 最後一天 Leah 看到了什麼？

items.promptZh: 兩匹白馬拉著那輛戰車。
referenceEn: Two white horses pulled the chariot.
The chariot was pulled by two white horses.
rubricZh: chariot 表示「（古代的）雙輪馬車、戰車」
可用主動或被動，寫法例如 pulled the chariot、was pulled by… 等
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 起飛的時候，我一直看著窗外。
referenceEn: During takeoff, I kept looking out of the window.
I kept looking out of the window during takeoff.
rubricZh: 用 takeoff 表示「起飛」（例如 during takeoff）
時態配合內容（例如 kept looking、was looking 等）
